InputQueryIntraChainBond.description:
Input defining a single bond between two atoms in the same chain.

Each endpoint of the bond requires a specification of a residue (either by residue ID
or residue index) and an atom (either by atom name or atom index). Optionally, a leaving
atom can be specified for each endpoint, which defines an atom which will be removed
from the structure (for example, OXT atoms are removed from the C-terminal residue
of an amino acid).

atom2_index.description: Endpoint 2's atom, by 0-based index. Only supported for SMILES/path chains.

leaving_atom2_index.description: Same as leaving_atom2_name, by index. Only supported for SMILES/path chains.

leaving_atom2_name.title: End Leaving Atom Name

OpenFold3PredictionScores.description: Confidence scores (and a few structural counts) returned for a prediction by OpenFold3.

atom_predicted_local_distance_difference.description: Per-atom predicted local distance difference test (pLDDT) score, in [0, 100]. Higher values indicate a higher confidence in the local atom position.
atom_predicted_local_distance_difference.title: Per-Atom Predicted Local Distance Difference Test (pLDDT)

atom_tokens.description: 0-based index of the token for each atom. A token is an internal grouping within the model - each polymer residue belongs to a single token, and each non-polymer/ligand heavy atom belongs to a single token.
atom_tokens.title: Atom Tokens

average_predicted_local_distance_differe.description: Mean of `atom_predicted_local_distance_difference_test` across all atoms, in [0, 100]. A single global confidence summary for the whole prediction.
average_predicted_local_distance_differe.title: Average Predicted Local Distance Difference Test (pLDDT)

chain_chain_interface_predicted_tm_score.description: Pairwise interface predicted TM-score between every pair of chains. The (i, j) entry is the ipTM computed over just chains i and j (the predicted structure's chain i/j, A, B, C, ...); symmetric. `null` if OpenFold3 didn't compute this pair (no inter-chain contact between chains i and j).
chain_chain_interface_predicted_tm_score.title: Chain-Chain Interface Predicted TM-Score (ipTM)

chain_predicted_tm_score.description: Per-chain predicted TM-score, between 0 and 1. The same pTM computation as `predicted_tm_score`, but restricted to a single chain's tokens. Index i is the predicted structure's chain i (A, B, C, ...).
chain_predicted_tm_score.title: Per-Chain Predicted TM-Score (pTM)

clash_flag.description: Does any pair of polymer chains have a steric clash.
clash_flag.title: Clash Flag

disorder.description: Disorder score: the average relative accessible surface area (RASA), computed from the predicted structure's coordinates, over residues the model left unresolved. Higher indicates more disorder. Only computed when the structure contains protein chains; 0.0 otherwise.
disorder.title: Disorder

global_predicted_distance_error.description: Global predicted distance error (gPDE), in Angstroms. A single scalar summary of `token_token_predicted_distance_error`, weighted by predicted inter-token contact probability. Lower is more confident.
global_predicted_distance_error.title: Global Predicted Distance Error (gPDE)

interface_predicted_tm_score.description: Interface predicted TM-score (ipTM), between 0 and 1. Similar to `predicted_tm_score`, but restricted to inter-chain contacts. Higher is more confident.
interface_predicted_tm_score.title: Interface Predicted TM-Score (ipTM)

model_ranking_score.description: OpenFold3's composite score used to rank diffusion samples. Equal to `0.8 * iptm + 0.2 * ptm + 0.5 * disorder - 100 * clash_flag`. Higher is better; the large clash penalty means any clash dominates the score.
model_ranking_score.title: Model Ranking Score

num_atoms.description: Total number of atoms in the predicted structure.
num_atoms.title: Number of Atoms

num_bonds.description: Total number of bonds in the predicted structure.
num_bonds.title: Number of Bonds

num_chains.description: Total number of chains in the predicted structure.
num_chains.title: Number of Chains

num_residues.description: Total number of residues in the predicted structure.
num_residues.title: Number of Residues

num_tokens.description: Total number of tokens in the predicted structure.
num_tokens.title: Number of Tokens

predicted_tm_score.description: Predicted TM-score (pTM) for the full complex, between 0 and 1. Estimate of the TM-score the prediction would achieve against the (unknown) true structure. Higher is more confident.
predicted_tm_score.title: Predicted TM-Score (pTM)

token_token_predicted_aligned_error.description: Predicted aligned error (PAE) for all pairs of tokens, in Angstroms. The (i, j) entry is the expected position error of token j if the structure were aligned on token i's local frame. Lower is more confident.
token_token_predicted_aligned_error.title: Token-Token Predicted Aligned Error (PAE)

token_token_predicted_distance_error.description: Predicted distance error (PDE) for all pairs of tokens, in Angstroms. The (i, j) entry is the expected error in the distance between tokens i and j; symmetric. Lower is more confident.
token_token_predicted_distance_error.title: Token-Token Predicted Distance Error (PDE)

parameters.description: Config for the Apheris OpenFold3 prediction wrapper.

msa_dir.description: Directory of precomputed MSA files. Protein/RNA chains without their own MSA are matched to one here by sequence, not by filename.
msa_dir.title: MSA Directory

num_diffusion_samples.description: Number of structures to sample from the diffusion model.
num_diffusion_samples.title: Diffusion Sample Count

seeds.description: Random seeds to use for prediction.
seeds.title: Seeds

template_paths.description: Optional template structure file(s) (CIF/PDB), applied to every query. Each protein/DNA/RNA chain is matched to its best-aligning chain (normalized global-alignment score >0.5) in each file - not by chain ID or order - so multiple files can each contribute one template per chain. Partial matches are allowed: some chains may remain untemplated as long as at least one eligible chain in the query matches. Validation only fails if none of the query's chains match any file. Ligands and other non-polymer entities are never templated.
template_paths.title: Template Structure Paths

weights.description: A valid OpenFold3 model checkpoint. Its OpenFold3 variant is inferred from the shape of its weights, not from the filename.
weights.title: Model Weights Path
